[package]
name = "notes"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.8.9"
form_urlencoded = "1.2.3"
rusqlite = { version = "0.43.0", features = ["bundled"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.154"
tokio = { version = "1.54.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net", "signal"] }

[dev-dependencies]
http-body-util = "0.1.5"
tower = { version = "0.5.3", features = ["util"] }

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary and places it at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/notes ./app
